transform_accounting.\u26a0\ufe0f_scope_changes_the_sign: pool_net says the ON arm carries MORE added artefact than OFF (so the normalised comparison is not flattering ON); row_gross says the opposite. pool_net is quoted because the claim it supports is a POOLED one.

dilution_control.what: OMR-NED is symmetric, so emitting FEWER symbols lowers it for free. If this were dilution, omr_ed would rise while the ratio fell.
